definitions.explanation: A descendant of a notable family, clan, or people, typically many generations removed.

examples.japanese: ⟦{王家|おうけ}→王家：13548_ouke⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{末裔|まつえい}。
examples.english: A descendant of the royal family.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{武士|ぶし}→武士：03989_bushi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{末裔|まつえい}だそうだ。
examples.english: They say he is descended from samurai.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{村|むら}→村：02261_mura⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{戦|たたか}い→戦い：02070_tatakai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{敗|やぶ}れた→敗れる：12712_yabureru⟧{平家|へいけ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{末裔|まつえい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{住|す}み{着|つ}いた⟦という→という：09577_toiu⟧⟦{伝説|でんせつ}→伝説：11446_densetsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: There is a legend that descendants of the defeated Heike clan settled in this village.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- 〜⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{末裔|まつえい}: a descendant of ~
- 〜⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{末裔|まつえい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧あたる: to be a descendant of ~

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{子孫|しそん}→子孫：00372_shison⟧: descendants, offspring; the general word, for any generation including one's own future children (⟦{子孫|しそん}→子孫：00372_shison⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{残|のこ}す→残す：01975_nokosu⟧). {末裔|まつえい} is literary and points back from the present to a famous line far in the past.
